title: Define generic EffectEnvelope contract
purpose: Create the transaction envelope that every AgentCore side effect must pass through from prepare to seal or rollback.
scope: Define EffectEnvelope with run_id, step_id, tool, normalized params, policy decision, lease, sandbox profile, prepared event, observed event, verification result, rollback handle, and commit id.
Define allowed envelope states: Draft, Prepared, Observed, Verified, Sealed, RollbackPending, RolledBack, FailedClosed.
Bind envelope state transitions to AuditJournal events.
Prevent AgentCore from fabricating sealed effects without Security Execution Foundation validation.
Define serialization and redaction rules for envelope fields.
acceptance_criteria: Every side-effecting Agent step can be represented by an EffectEnvelope.
EffectPrepared must precede EffectObserved for any observed effect.
CommitSealed requires a successful verification result.
RollbackPending cannot be skipped for failed write-with-diff verification.
verification: Test invalid transition sequences and confirm rejection.
Compare envelope events with AuditJournal unresolved effect queries.
risk_notes: This contract is what prevents AgentCore from treating an attempted action as a completed action.
